verses.text: Understand this: the last days will be difficult.
People will love themselves and money. They'll brag and act arrogantly, insult God, disobey their parents, show no gratitude, and reject what is holy.
They'll have no natural affection, refuse to make peace, slander others, lack self-control, act brutally, and hate what is good.
They'll betray people, act recklessly, become conceited, and love pleasure instead of God.
They'll look religious but reject its power. Stay away from people like that.
Some of them worm their way into homes and take control of vulnerable women burdened with sins and led by all kinds of desires.
These women are always learning but never able to reach a full understanding of the truth.
Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people oppose the truth. Their minds are corrupt, and their faith is counterfeit.
But they won't get far. Their foolishness will become clear to everyone, just as it did with those two.
You have followed my teaching, way of life, purpose, faith, patience, love, and endurance.
You know about my persecutions and sufferings in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured them all, and the Lord rescued me from them all.
In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
But evil people and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving others and being deceived themselves.
But you must stay with what you learned and became convinced of, because you know who taught you.
From childhood you've known the holy Scriptures, which can make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
All Scripture is breathed out by God and is useful for teaching, exposing error, correcting, and training people in righteousness,
so that everyone who belongs to God may be capable and fully equipped for every good work.
